verified_claim_families: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution digital terrain model intended for landscape analysis over large areas.
Grid and contour products are supplied separately in 10km by 10km National Grid tiles.
The grid has regular 50m post spacing and is available in ASCII grid and GML 3.2.1.
Contour data is distinct from the raster grid and includes 10m contours and spot heights.
ASCII height values are calculated at pixel centres.
The raster origin used for reading values is at the north-west corner of the tile.
Rows run west to east and subsequent rows proceed southward.
Each Terrain 50 tile has 200 columns and 200 rows with 50m cells.
ASCII height values are recorded to the nearest 0.1m.
The ASCII header includes ncols, nrows, xllcorner, yllcorner and cellsize.
GML accompanying the ASCII supply provides location, grid spacing, vertical reference and spatial reference metadata.
GML geometries use EPSG:27700 expressed as an OGC CRS URN.
Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI and records product, grid or contour representation, tile reference and coordinate reference information.
OS Terrain 50 is refreshed by whole tile rather than feature-based change-only updates, so identifiers can be regenerated on tile refresh.
Grid pixel-centre values must not be substituted with contour or spot-height values.
Exact official TQ29 archive bytes, header values and the two candidate cell heights were not read back in this runtime.
